calendar-feed.module.name: Calendar feed
calendar-feed.module.description: One private calendar address for each person, with everything they are on: shifts, calls, sessions and meetings, kept up to date in their own calendar app. It has no switch: it comes on with any module that adds to it, such as Front of house.
calendar-feed.file.name: My theatre calendar
calendar-feed.account.title: Your calendar
calendar-feed.account.summary: Everything you are on, in your own calendar app
calendar-feed.panel.description: Subscribe in your calendar app and everything you are on appears there and stays up to date. Anyone with this address can see what you are on, so keep it to yourself.
calendar-feed.panel.reset: Make a new address and stop the old one
calendar-feed.navigation.mine.label: Your calendar
